query:
SELECT s.name, s.enrollment, c.classCode, comp.code as component_code, cs.classId,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions ses WHERE ses.classId = cs.classId AND ses.status = 'finished') as finished_sessions,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sessions ses WHERE ses.classId = cs.classId) as total_sessions
FROM students s
JOIN class_students cs ON s.id = cs.studentId
JOIN classes c ON cs.classId = c.id
JOIN components comp ON c.componentId = comp.id
WHERE s.enrollment = '23211323';
